one_line: Mughal emperor Aurangzeb, directing the grueling 1687 siege that brought down the Qutb Shahi Sultanate at Golconda.

appearance.age_look: Early 60s, lean and slightly stooped but wiry, with the quiet intensity of an aging commander who still rides to war.
appearance.face: Long, narrow face with a high forehead, sharp nose, and neatly trimmed pointed grey beard; wheatish North Indian complexion with sun-weathered lines; deep, observant eyes under slightly furrowed brows; default expression calm, calculating, almost detached.
appearance.hair: Hair mostly hidden beneath a tall white muslin Mughal turban wrapped in layered folds, slightly conical with a gentle tilt, accented by a slim gold turban band; a few wisps of grey hair visible at the temples, tied back neatly at the nape.
appearance.costume: A long, finely striped jamdani muslin jama in muted ivory and pale beige, crossing left over right and tied with an olive-green cloth patka at the waist; over it, a sleeveless quilted light-cream cotton coat (nimqaba) reaching mid-thigh, subtly padded and stitched in vertical channels; loose churidar trousers in soft dull-olive cotton gathered at the ankles; a long, plain white wool shawl draped over one shoulder and around his back for warmth and austerity; on his feet, closed, slightly upturned brown leather Mughal shoes (khussa) with simple stitching; minimal jewellery—a single slender gold ring and a small, functional metal seal-ring—emphasizing his austere piety.
appearance.signature: A sheathed, lightly curved Mughal talwar with a dark steel hilt and plain round pommel, its worn leather scabbard dyed deep brown and hanging from a simple olive-green cloth baldric slanting across his chest, which he rests a hand on while overseeing the siege.

ref_desc: Aurangzeb is a wiry, older Mughal emperor with a long narrow face, grey pointed beard, tall white muslin turban, ivory striped jama with quilted light-cream sleeveless coat, olive-green sash and churidar, brown leather khussa shoes, and a plain brown-sheathed talwar on an olive-green baldric.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Aurangzeb as an older Mughal emperor at the 1687 siege of Golconda: a wiry man in his early sixties with a long narrow face, wheatish complexion, sharp nose, deep observant eyes, and a neatly trimmed grey pointed beard, his default expression calm and calculating. His hair is mostly hidden under a tall white muslin Mughal turban wrapped in layered folds, slightly conical and gently tilted, with a slim gold band at the base and a few grey wisps visible at the temples. He wears an ivory and pale-beige striped jamdani muslin jama crossing left over right, tied with an olive-green cloth sash, over which sits a sleeveless quilted light-cream cotton coat reaching mid-thigh, stitched in vertical channels. His loose olive-green churidar trousers gather at the ankles above closed, slightly upturned brown leather khussa shoes with simple stitching. A long plain white wool shawl is draped over one shoulder and around his back, emphasizing austerity, with only a slender gold ring and a functional metal seal-ring as jewellery. His signature weapon is a sheathed, lightly curved Mughal talwar with a dark steel hilt and plain round pommel in a worn deep-brown leather scabbard hanging from an olive-green cloth baldric across his chest, one hand resting calmly on the hilt. Use a muted palette of ivory, pale beige, olive green, white, and brown leather, and show him in neutral, front, side, and back poses to emphasize the fixed face, turban, layered garments, and talwar placement.
